CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

2. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 9

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

5. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 8

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 17
   C. 21
   D. 15

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 64

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 82

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 11
   C. 28
   D. 3

13. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
